relations.rationale: Both statements describe team assignments among the same people, but knowing Cleo and Yara differ doesn't determine whether Dara and Yara differ.
Cleo and Yara being on different teams implies there are at least two teams, supporting the claim there were two teams.
Vik's age relative to Dara has no bearing on the garden's activity level at midmorning.
The break is the context in which they shared coffee and pastries, so the break supports the idea of that shared activity.
A short break around ten is compatible with and could be part of a generally busy midmorning, but it doesn't establish overall buzzing activity.
Both describe a pause in work, likely referring to the same event of taking a break to admire progress.
Dara and Yara being on different teams implies there are at least two teams, supporting the two-team claim.
The garden buzzing with activity is elaborated by the specific sounds of rakes and laughter, so it supports that description.
The buzzing activity in the garden aligns with the later description of the group pausing to admire progress made from that activity.
